components.name: Primary Button
components.description: High-priority action for registering or submitting a product.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 39px; padding: 0 13px; color: var(--signal-ink); background: var(--signal); border: 1px solid var(--signal); border-radius: var(--radius-small); font: 700 12px 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background .16s ease, color .16s ease, border-color .16s ease, transform .16s ease; } .ds-button-primary:hover:not(:disabled) { background: #ffe044; border-color: #ffe044; } .ds-button-primary:active:not(:disabled) { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--signal); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-button-primary:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; opacity: .55; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Lower-emphasis action for navigation, cancellation, and supporting tasks.
components.css: .ds-button-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 39px; padding: 0 13px; color: var(--ink-soft); background: var(--surface-raised); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: var(--radius-small); font: 700 12px 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background .16s ease, color .16s ease, border-color .16s ease, transform .16s ease; } .ds-button-secondary:hover:not(:disabled) { color: var(--ink); background: var(--surface-hover); } .ds-button-secondary:active:not(:disabled) { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-button-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--signal); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-button-secondary:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; opacity: .55; }

components.name: Catalog Search
components.description: Searches product names, ASINs, or URLs within the catalog.
components.html: <label class='ds-search'><svg aria-hidden='true' viewBox='0 0 24 24'><circle cx='10.8' cy='10.8' r='6.3' fill='none' stroke='currentColor' stroke-width='1.8'/><path d='m15.5 15.5 4.2 4.2' fill='none' stroke='currentColor' stroke-width='1.8'/></svg><input type='search' placeholder='Nombre, ASIN o URL' aria-label='Buscar productos'></label>
components.css: .ds-search { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px; min-width: 170px; height: 37px; padding: 0 10px; color: var(--ink-muted); background: #0e1215; border: 1px solid #333d44; border-radius: var(--radius-small); } .ds-search:focus-within { border-color: #7a6b1c; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(255, 212, 0, .08); } .ds-search svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; flex: 0 0 auto; } .ds-search input { width: 100%; min-width: 0; color: var(--ink); background: transparent; border: 0; outline: 0; font: 400 11px 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif; } .ds-search input::placeholder { color: var(--ink-dim); opacity: 1; }

components.name: Registration Field
components.description: Accepts an Amazon ASIN or a supported marketplace URL.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; color: var(--ink-soft); font: 700 10px 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif; } .ds-field input { width: 100%; height: 43px; padding: 0 11px; color: var(--ink); background: #0c1013; border: 1px solid #48535a; border-radius: var(--radius-small); font: 400 12px 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif; } .ds-field input::placeholder { color: var(--ink-dim); opacity: 1; } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--signal); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Active Navigation Item
components.description: Marks the current workspace destination with a selected surface and narrow accent edge.
components.css: .ds-nav-item { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; width: 100%; min-height: 43px; padding: 0 10px; color: var(--ink); background: #1b2227; border: 1px solid #323b41; border-radius: var(--radius-small); text-align: left; font: 600 13px 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-nav-item::after { position: absolute; top: 9px; right: -1px; bottom: 9px; width: 2px; content: ''; background: var(--signal); } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: #20272d; } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--signal); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-nav-icon { width: 18px; height: 18px; flex: 0 0 auto; color: var(--ink-soft); }

components.name: Query Status Badge
components.description: Pairs a compact icon marker and text label with query state.
components.html: Error
components.css: .ds-status-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; min-height: 23px; padding: 2px 7px; color: #ffaaa3; background: var(--error-wash); border: 1px solid #623533; border-radius: 4px; font: 700 9px/1.15 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-status-icon { width: 12px; height: 12px; flex: 0 0 auto; }

components.name: Catalog Surface
components.description: Frames the filter row and product table as one working surface.
components.css: .ds-catalog { overflow: hidden; padding: 16px; color: var(--ink); background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: var(--radius); font: 700 12px 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif; }

components.css: .ds-product-table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; } .ds-product-row { background: transparent; transition: background .17s ease; } .ds-product-row:hover { background: #171d21; } .ds-product-row--changed { background: #19180f; box-shadow: inset 0 1px #4d4519, inset 0 -1px #4d4519; } .ds-product-row--changed:hover { background: #201e11; } .ds-product-table td { padding: 13px 11px; color: var(--ink-soft); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line-soft); font: 400 11px/1.45 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif; } .ds-change-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; padding: 2px 7px; color: var(--signal); background: #2a2610; border: 1px solid #5b4e14; border-radius: 4px; font: 700 9px 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif; } .ds-change-badge::before { width: 7px; height: 7px; content: ''; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--signal); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(255, 212, 0, .1); } @media (max-width: 680px) { .ds-product-table { display: block; min-width: 0; } .ds-product-table thead { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; overflow: hidden; clip: rect(0, 0, 0, 0); } .ds-product-table tbody { display: grid; gap: 9px; padding: 9px; } .ds-product-row, .ds-product-row--changed { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 0 12px; padding: 12px 11px 9px; background: #151a1e; border: 1px solid #323b42; border-radius: 6px; box-shadow: none; } .ds-product-row--changed { background: #1a190f; border-color: #5a501a; box-shadow: inset 0 1px #75651c; } .ds-product-table td { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(72px, .55fr) minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 8px; padding: 8px 0; border: 0; font-size: 10px; } .ds-product-table td::before { content: attr(data-label); color: var(--ink-dim); font-size: 8px; font-weight: 700; } .ds-product-table td[data-label='Producto'] { grid-column: 1 / -1; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line-soft); } }

narrative.overview:
IMX Scout is an Operate interface for registering products and following their marketplace data. Its working language is graphite and cool silver, with Plus Jakarta Sans and compact, familiar web controls. The product catalog is the default view, and each product row holds the identity, latest valid result, latest query attempt, status, change signal, and related actions together.

The yellow signal marks unread changes and selected priority; red marks failed checks; muted green marks successful checks. Tabular numerals keep prices and times easy to compare. Surface contrast and fine borders organize the dense catalog, while the summary and alerts views support the same product-centered workflow.
keyCharacteristics: Product-first catalog with stable, scannable data columns.
Graphite surfaces and cool-silver text and dividers.
Yellow unread-change signal, with red failure and muted-green success states.
Plus Jakarta Sans with tabular numerals for data values.
Standard web navigation, forms, filters, tables, dialogs, and drawers.

rules.name: The Status-With-Text Rule
rules.body: Every status uses a visible label or explanatory copy alongside its color treatment.

rules.name: The Numeric-Alignment Rule
rules.body: Prices, timestamps, and comparisons retain tabular numerals so changing values keep their columns visually steady.

rules.name: The Product-Row Rule
rules.body: Keep identity, latest valid data, latest query attempt, status, unread change, and next actions in the same product row at every viewport.

rules.name: The Flat-At-Rest Rule
rules.body: Panels and rows use tonal contrast and borders at rest; reserve shadows for overlays and active state cues.

dos: Do keep product identity, the latest valid values, the latest query attempt, status, unread change, and next actions together in its row.
Do label a retained value as the last valid data when the latest attempt failed.
Do pair yellow, red, and green status colors with readable text and the interface's icon or detail treatment.
Do use tabular numerals for prices, timestamps, and comparison values.
Do keep the product catalog as the first working view and preserve the standard navigation, filters, forms, tables, and responsive row cards.
Do preserve the IMX Scout name and Plus Jakarta Sans.
donts: Don't imply that the last known value is the result of a failed or unavailable query.
Don't use color as the only explanation of a change, success, warning, or failure.
Don't turn the primary catalog into disconnected summary tiles; the product row is the unit that carries its result and state.
Don't introduce a different typeface or replace the graphite, cool-silver, and yellow signal palette with unrelated accents.
